heading: Choose Craft for a planned color appointment and a choice of two studios
body:
Put Craft Collective on your shortlist when you want to choose a stylist from a visible portfolio, plan a color change before booking, and compare appointments in North Hills or Canonsburg. Our published menu includes balayage, highlights, blonding, extensions and smoothing services.

For a brunette-to-brighter result, bring your current color history and ask which reservation includes the placement, toner and finish you want. Confirm the stylist’s studio before choosing a time. Canonsburg appointments are arranged by phone.

heading: Choose Craft when stylist fit and the full color plan come first
body:
Craft is a strong option when you want to compare individual stylist work before deciding on balayage, highlights, blonding or extensions. Use our team and gallery pages to find work that resembles your goal, then confirm the service and studio with the salon.

Ask for an estimate that identifies the first appointment and expected upkeep. That gives you a useful basis for comparing salons without assuming two similarly named services include the same work.

heading: Choose Craft for a color consultation with location options
body:
Consider Craft when you want to plan your color result around a particular stylist’s portfolio and choose between our North Hills and Canonsburg studios. Our service range includes haircuts, dimensional color, balayage, blonding and extensions.

Tell us what you want to preserve as well as what you want to change. Confirm your stylist’s location, the complete service estimate and how to book maintenance before committing to the appointment.

heading: Choose Craft for a stylist-led plan for color, cut and upkeep
body:
Craft offers a practical starting point when your goal combines a cut, dimensional color or extensions and you want to review the stylist’s work first. Explore the team and gallery, then ask which service block fits your current hair and desired finish.

Our North Hills and Canonsburg locations give you two studio options; confirm where the selected stylist works. Discuss maintenance and the full estimate so the result fits both your routine and your appointment budget.
